title: NZ MBIE Determination 2025/040 (comparative): bamboo cladding system with appraisal, purported refusal
jurisdiction: New Zealand (Building Act 2004); Auckland Council; comparative only, not Alberta
code_edition: NZ Building Code (Schedule 1, Building Regulations 1992) as cited; acceptable-solution edition not stated in extracted text
source_url_note: Building CodeHub resource page for the same MBIE determination (Information provider: MBIE); the building.govt.nz determination page is WAF-blocked for this worker.

facts.text: The authority's purported refusal concerned building consent for a single-level three-bedroom detached dwelling.
The dwelling was to be clad in sealed masonry blocks, vertical profiled metal, fibre cement panels and a vertical bamboo weatherboard system on a cavity.
The bamboo cladding system is an alternative solution accompanied by a building product appraisal certificate.
On 5 September 2024 the owners lodged building consent application BCO10387092.
The determination examines whether the authority gave clear reasons under section 50 for the purported refusal.
